[b]WMW company operates in Hydronia[/b]

After negotiations with the WMW company, a military vehicle manufacturer based in Camphill, the Hydronian government has permitted the construction of 3 factories. 1 in Hydropolis industrial sector A, 1 in Hydropolis industrial sector B and 1 in the southern industrial town of Demirtas, state of Yukesel. In return, the Hydronian government will receive 50% of the produced vehicles from these 3 factories to help the war effort against the Kaiserreich.

[quote=technokratisches_kaiserreich;60015598][spoiler=[b]OOC Stuff[/b]]

-Acoustic missiles arent used for a variety of reasons in the air. Sound quickly dissipates and is affected by a wide range of factors including humidity, wind etc. The noise of the engine also makes them highly inaccurate. 

-Making the mach 6 missiles extremely maneuverable due to light airframes is probably unrealistic. Speeding up to mach 6, slowing down rapidly and then being able to speed up to mach 6 again would require heavy and extremely expensive systems like rocket boosters with scram jets that are capable of switching modes and variable thrust. The missile would also need a ton of thermal protection to handle massive changes in heat and airflow weighing it down further. 

-Machine gunners and snipers hiding behind hills from a 5,000 lb JDAM probably wouldnt protect them. The US used JDAMs to hit deeply entrenched cave complexes in Afghanistan so a couple hills probably wouldnt be very effective in protecting them.[/spoiler]  

[spoiler=[b]Reichswehr Offensive[/b]]

After heavy damage was done to the Hydronian oil industry, the Reichswehr would utilize another card up its sleeve to deal with the remaining oil infrastructure. The B25-EL strategic stealth bomber developed in coordination with Jomsland and the Oceanice Republic would take to the skies from Reichswehr controlled air bases in Hydronian territory. With a loadout of 40,000 lbs in ordinance the B25-ELs would move south with the purpose of crippling the Hydronian oil industry permanently. Its stealth capabilities would make it nearly impossible to intercept. The design of the aircraft including its flying wing shape as well as purposeful configuration would make it appear as small as an insect on radar. Radar absorbing materials would absorb radar waves instead of reflecting them. The engines of the aircraft are burned inside its fuselage, this on top of cooling would give it almost no infrared signature. Flying into Hydronian territory at night and at extremely high altitudes would further reduce the chances of interception. Upon reaching the south of Hydronia, each of the aircraft would unload 40,000 lbs of ordinance onto the oil infrastructure. JDAMs would be dropped onto oil refineries, pipelines, loading docks, petrochemical factories and strategic stockpiles of petrol. The purpose of this would be to not only deal a massive economic blow to the Hydronians but to also to destroy the oil used in the war effort. Ships, armored vehicles, aircraft, and other vehicles would all be indirectly impacted by the raid. 

Jamming and chaff would have little effect on the Gunslinger missiles as they made their way towards the Hydronian aircraft. The collaborative interfaces used to guide the missiles wouldnt be disturbed. On top of the aircraft, ships and other radars now ground based radar would also provide insight into the location of Hydronian aircraft. Infrared systems onboard would also help the missiles track the heat signature coming off the engines of the Hydronian aircraft. Dozens of eyes from the air, ground and sea would ensure the deadly accuracy of the Gunslinger and Rakete missiles as they fly towards the Hydronian jets. The accuracy of acoustic missiles would be highly dubious. Sound dissipates quickly in air and is easily affected by wind and humidity on top of the sound of the missiles. Fine tuning for the sounds of very silent rotors would be like searching for a needle in a stack of hay. Ultimately, the interceptors would probably be ineffective and more importantly a waste of resources. A most likely multi-million dollar interceptor, even if by some miracle using acoustic sensors hit a drone it would have little effect on the war effort. These mass producible drones, costing only 50k each, would flood into Hydronian airspace. The missiles are definitely experimental, the Reichswehr would observe, and should have stayed in theory rather than on the realities of the battlefield. 

Under-keel sonar would allow the fleet to look directly below them at the submarines. The Hydronians falsely believed that staying underneath them would provide them cover but sticking so close made them quick targets. Under-keel sonar paired with detection utilized by UUVs and EDU submarines would allow the ATTs to accurately intercept the torpedoes. While most torpedoes are intercepted some manage to break through and sink the TKS Eisenwald guided missile cruiser. The rest of the fleet, however, sustains minor damage. Now, however, the Reichswehr would counterattack. The Hydronian subs, coming close to the surface to launch their torpedoes and extremely close to the under keel sonar would be clearly identifiable. The TKS Hohenkrone submarine would fire dozens of torpedoes towards the enemy submarines. The fire from the submarine would be joined by helicopters, surface ships, and maritime patrol aircraft giving the Kaiserreich overwhelming firepower. The Sturmfisch torpedoes would have a variety of countermeasures that work to maximize their chances of destroying the enemy submarines. Due to the close range of the submarines, the Sturmfisch sprints to 70 knots allowing it to quickly close the gap and avoid slower ATTs. Using unpredictable maneuvers it also aims to throw off interceptors and it also utilizes acoustic counter-countermeasures to quickly identify between decoys, targets and defensive torpedoes. While moving towards the enemy submarines the torpedoes have yet another defensive mechanism up its sleeve. Acoustic decoys that mimic the signature of the torpedoes are deployed to waste ATTs while acoustic jammers work to blind the submarine's sonar. The wide range of firing platforms: submarines, UUVs, aircraft, and surface craft allow massed saturation attacks to even further maximize the chance of completely destroying the Hydronian submarine fleet. On top of torpedoes fired from aircraft, helicopters, submarines and surface craft the Kaiserreichs UUVs would continue their assaults. Jamming would have little to no effect on the fully autonomous systems which dont rely on constant links with their surface controllers. The massive swarm would easily shoulder the hits of torpedoes, the individual UUVs being easily expendable due to their low cost. Submarines trying to enact evasive maneuvers would find it near impossible to shake off the swarm. A hive mind of collective intelligence used to control the swarm, trained off trillions of data points would constantly identify and keep up the chase. Constantly firing torpedoes, the UUVs not only work to destroy the submarines but also waste their vital supplies of dwindling ATTs as the main strike arrives. 

AAV soft kill systems would be activated to deal with the incoming barrage of missiles. Widespread spoofing would be used to mislead the missiles and confuse their targeting systems to reduce the risk of interception. On top of this other soft kill systems would be deployed. Smoke screens would be launched to cover the moving armored vehicles to break the lock. Finally any remaining missiles would be dealt with by the active protection systems. From the skies,  the EK-18 electronic warfare aircraft begin DFRM to intercept radar signals and send false signals to mislead the man portable systems. Small interceptor munitions would be used to hit the missiles before they arrive. Three layers of defense would prove effective, however, two AAVs would be destroyed nonetheless. By this time, however, the beachhead had been fully secured with the constant movements of armored vehicles into the area quickly filling the losses. 

The Hydronians had attempted to use their portable missile systems as a cure all for their lack of combined arms fire. However, they wouldnt prove anywhere near effective with the cruise missiles. The extremely high speeds of the Donnerkeil cruise missiles would make interception using man portable missiles extremely improbable. Cruise missiles also significantly outrange the man-portable missiles(US javelin: 2.5 km, stinger: 4 km) allowing them to outrun and then outrange them. The same situation would happen with the jets. Firing towards the jets would prove rather ineffective as well. Dropping JDAMs from high altitudes including from 35,000 feet would keep the jets far from the man-portable missiles as they drop JDAMs onto those missile launchers. 

The J-16s would quickly strike back against the missile launchers, machine gunners and snipers. Their tactic of hiding behind hills would be quickly unraveled as the 5,000 lb JDAMs fell. The massive ordinance combined with UAV surveillance would be easily able to slam into the men even if they were hiding in the hills. The 5,000 lb JDAMs had been used to crush Sikirskian troops in the mountains of Nestorstaat, the hills of Hydronia wouldnt be any more challenging. Machine gun fire onto the LCACs would prove ineffective. Fast speeds, significant distances and active protections systems would ward off the majority of machine gun attacks. 

The J-15Es use their vast array of electronic warfare capabilities to hinder the air to air missiles. Barrage jamming would be utilized by flooding a wide array of frequencies with static to block guidance systems. At the same time spoofing is utilized by making fake targets appear on the targeting systems of the missiles to mislead them. For infrared tracking missiles flares that burn hotter than the engines of the jets would be deployed to lead them away. Cheaper direct energy weapons are used on the J-16s to intercept the incoming missiles as a kinetic strike. 

Radar absorbing materials on the jets allow them to absorb radar pings to appear much smaller than they are. However, the lack of targeting abilities on the Hydronian missiles would let the J-16s to simply move out of the way to avoid being hit. 

Using the above mentioned anti-submarine tactics the escort ships would work to intercept the submarines far before they are able to hit the supply ships. 

The descending paratroopers, spread out over an area cover a very small volume of space while dispersed. The chances of random spraying of machine gun fire in hitting a paratrooper would be highly unlikely. Reichswehr paratroopers would use their advanced equipment as a force multiplier against the larger Hydronian forces. Using their thermal sights, combined their laser range finders and ACOG 4x magnification scopes they would be able to accurately shoot the wildly firing Hydronian forces. Use of FPV drones would be widespread as the paratroopers utilize suicide drones to bomb groups of Hydronian troops and armored vehicles at relatively low costs. Engaging Hydronian troops would be part of the plan. Once encountering enemy fire the paratroopers would call in rapid air support. Within minutes JDAMs and cluster munitions would be dropped onto the enemy by J-16s.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Pushing Into the East[/b]]

By the third day of landings a combined force of 75,000 Reichswehr troops had been brought in via LCAC and helicopter landings. Along with heavy tanks, AAVs and IFVs the heavily armored Reichswehr troops would begin to rapidly push into eastern Hydronia. Followed by close air support provided by the JDAMs of the J-16s, the Reichswehr would utilize overwhelming firepower to push further and further into the country. As they push further into the country, the Engineer Korps establish landing zones and runways to airlift in supplies and troops. K-130s defended by J-15Es and ground based air defense systems help swell the numbers of troops and armored vehicles in the area. 

As they go the Engineer Korps helps repair roads, build makeshift bridges and remove mines along with autonomous systems. Forward repair units, supply trucks, medevac and petrol follow close behind to sustain the heavy arms advance into Hydronia. Unlike the Hydronians, whose oil infrastructure was hit by hundreds of Donnerkeil cruise missiles along with a B-25EL strike, the armored vehicles of the Kaiserreich are well supplied. Fuel bladders along with oil tankers help provide constant fuel to the armored divisions to outmatch their Hydronian counterparts.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Defending[/b]]
[i]*OOC: you don't control any of my airbases so imma just act as if this bomber was launched from a ship offshore*[/i]
The bomber may have been impossible to intercept, especially with damaged radar and antiair, but it's payload was not. High power, yet small and portable jamming units that had been transported and set up at critical infrastructure over the past few days would be used to misguide and confuse the incoming JDAMS, whilst a THEP satellite would feed the JDAMs false information, guiding them to uninhabited fields where they would explode harmlessly.

The Hydronian aircraft would have to resort to launching their interceptors. Air-to-air interceptor missiles would be launched at the incoming gunslingers and raketes. Laser homing would allow the missiles lock onto the incoming gunslingers and raketes with high accuracy. They would then chase down the missiles, whilst the Hydronian aircraft did evasive maneuvers and escaped. The acoustic missiles would prove to still be very experimental. As such, new tactics would be employed. As the drones enter Hydronian airspace, they would be easily visible, without the need for radar. Swarms of drones would be let loose from airbases on the main island, which were yet to be hit. These drones would make use of optical guidance systems, along with small infrared sensors and radar imaging to detect the enemy drones. The Hydronian drones would move in a swarm to begin with to overwhelm the kaiserreich, but could split up if needed to. These drones would have high-power explosives attached to them. These explosives could be dropped onto the kaiserreich drones from above, or the Hydronian drones could simply crash into them, causing a massive explosion which could knock out nearby drones too. The sheer number of these drones would also allow them to easily overwhelm their Kaiserreich counterparts.

Fire from helicopters and above-the-water vehicles would prove ineffective. The submarines could quickly dive back to deep depths, concealing themselves from the aircraft above using the underwater terrain and their tactics of moving underneath the kaiserreich fleet would simply shield them, or the aircraft would risk hitting their own fleet. Before the enemy submarines had even launched their torpedoes, the Hydronians were already diving deeper as part of their usual tactical routine. Upon detecting incoming torpedoes on radar the submarines would continue to dive deeper now at full speed, attempting to go below the depth range of the torpedoes whilst small ATTs would be launched against the incoming torpedoes. Moving erratically would slow down the incoming sturmfisches, but they would still be faster than submarines, so the ATTs had to act fast. The ATTs would use acoustic sensors to home in on real torpedoes, which have a distinct sound hard to replicate as an acoustic decoy. Constant frequency switching would allow the ATTs to bypass jamming.  Small, relatively cheap torpedoes would continue to be fired at the UUVs, slowly dwindling their numbers, whilst ATTs are used to protect the submarines against the UUVs torpedoes. The numbers of ATTs left would begin to dwindle, but by diving below the depth range of the torpedoes, the submarines would be able to save their supplies.

The man-portable missiles would fail to do significant damage or stop the incoming cruise missiles. The hills would be hit, causing heavy casualties. The JDAMs would also cause significant losses. The kaiserreich had managed to push the Hydronians off the beaches. The Hydronian forces began to rapidly retreat, but Hydronia had a plan, all was not yet lost.

The paratroopers would land relatively safely, despite the machine gun fire, but on the ground they would encounter resistance. The drones would be shot out of the sky easily by snipers. Once engaged by Hydronian forces, the paratroopers would easily be overwhelmed. The Hydronians would send out scouting teams to find, surround and kill individual paratroopers. The teams would stay low, making use of camoflauge in familiar terrain. Once they located a paratrooper or a group of paratroopers using infrared goggles, they would surround them and open fire. The incoming JDAMs would be dealt with easily by small, yet powerful jamming units, which would disrupt their GPS signals, misguiding the JDAMs to unoccupied areas. One scouting team would fall victim to the cluster munitions, but after this incident quick communication would notify the other teams of the kaiserreich's dirty tactics. The teams would be much quicker to shoot down the paratroopers, before escaping the area swiftly and moving on to locate more paratroopers.
[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Resistance[/b]]
After the retreat from the beaches, Hydronia would begin piling troops into the state of Lumir. Quick deployment from army bases across the country would allow a total of 90,000 troops, 600 tanks and 400 armoured vehicles to be deployed in a matter of days. Whilst troops and vehicles continue to move in, the Hydronians would begin to fully engage the kaiserreich on the frontlines. Hydronia's army would be significantly larger, allowing them to easily overwhelm the kaiserreich troops and push them back. Armed to the teeth with artillery, the Hydronians would begin pumelling the kaiserreich on the frontlines. Additionally, rounds surface-to-surface missiles would be launched from behind lines and kaiserreich targets such as landing areas and armoured vehicles, oil tankers and the K-130s. On the ground, troops would make use of previously mentioned jamming units to misguide the JDAMs, whilst surface-to-air missiles would be launched at the technocratic jets in the air.

The Hydronians also knew that air support was crucial, so a risky move would be pulled. An armada of jets woudl be deployed from airbases on the main island and those that survived the earlier attacks. A combined force of 200 jets and 70 attack helicopters would begin attacks on the kaiserreich presence in the air and their ground forces. Air-to-surface missiles would be launched against kaiserreich troops, whilst air-to-air missiles would take on the J-16s and J-15Es. The Hydronian jets would also use hit-and-run tactics with at least two jets taking on a single Kaiserreich jet at once, rather than straight on dogfighting to make themselves harder to target. To counter the Kaiserreichs multi-input radar on their missiles, the aircraft would make use of jamming targeted at radar on the ground rather than individual missiles to disrupt the radar.  The larger numbers of aircraft were bound to suffer casualties, but due to the overwhelming nature of the attack, would be able to easily take on the kaiserreich and regain air superiority.

Whilst this was all happening on the mainland, the Hydronians had pulled a sneaky move. A stealth, nuclear-powered submarine had been deployed from a secret port in the south of the main island. For the next 2 days, the submarine would travel through the eastern strait towards the kaiserreich supply lines. The submarine would stay deep underwater and make use of radar and sonar absorbing materials to avoid detection. Additionally, it would be able to mask itself in the familiar oceanic terrain to further prevent sonar detection. It's nuclear-powered nature would also allow it to bypass acoustic sensors and a hydrodynamic shape allows it to produce small wakes. These measures combined would make Hydronia's submarine near-impossible to detect, letting it slip straight through the kaiserreich's fingers.
[/spoiler]

[quote=western_view;60014121][spoiler=Search, Rescue, and Investigate][b][i]Wetsern View Paper[/i][/b]
After a few weeks of searching, rescue teams finally found something. An inflatable life raft, with a tarp over it, inside they found two people. They were both rushed to the hospital, both had been exposed to the elements for way to long. Luckily they're currently in stable condition, mostly due to Western View's amazing doctors. The two people have been confirmed to be from the SS Leviathan, and have been fully identified. They are two of the ships bridge crew, Antonio Gasduiy (gasd-oo-E), and Joe Hangradais (Hangr-a-dias). Currently investigators from the WVTSB (Western View Transportation Safety Bureau) have been waiting for Antonia and Joe to be released from the hospital. While they wait, the WVTSB investigates the little clues they have. they have determined that the paper came from the ships files, and that the ship was not attacked by another country, because the SS Leviathan was fitted with sirens incase there was an external attack, but that doesn't rule out a bomb or a terrorist attack. The WVTSB has been searching for the wreck of the lost ship, with the militaries help, of course. Head council member Tony Messiaon has come yesterday with a speech about the lost ship, which has been getting a lot of attention, in his speech he stated, "This is a sad day for many, there are still 38 missing, I know, but we must keep moving forward, we must keep helping this country survive, and to thrive, even in the utmost of circumstances, but we are allowed to feel sad, or angry, we should feel sad and angry, in fact let us have a minute of silence for those missing right now." As the country of Western View grieves the missing, the search for any clues, survivors, or the wreck are in full swing, a quarter of the Wessernian navy and air force is involved in the search, and people are on the beaches searching for wreckage. After his speech Tony Messiaon has asked for an "Entire search, I do not think [nation]Technokratisches Kaiserreich[/nation] will help, but I will ask anyway, all countries that border the Nestor Ocean, please search your beaches for any pieces of metal, if you do find any, and are unable to identify it, please send it to us, and if you do identify it as the SS Leviathan's please send it to us immediately." There have been reports of oil in the ocean, so volunteers are coming to help save the dolphins, and other species from the growing crisis.[/spoiler]

The WVTSB (Western View Transpiration Safety Bureau) has come out earlier today with an exciting announcement about the SS Leviathan, they have found a lot of floating debris, in fact, the debris has many clues to how the SS Leviathan sank. The WVTSB sated in a report, "The floating debris found has  been identified as part of the port section of the hull, near where the majority of the oil onboard was held. The debris also shows signs of an explosion, many pieces are burned, and are bent outwards. The WVIB (Western View Investigation Bureau) has been sent to examine the wreckage for explosive residue, for this could have been a bomb, but we cannot be certain until the test are finished." Many people have been anxious to get the results back, for the could determine how 38 people are dead, since the rescue operations on Western View's side have ended, but Technokratisches Kaiserreich is still looking, as far as we know. But with one rescue operation coming to an end a new one begins. Many ships can be seen in the Nestor Ocean yesterday, all of them volunteers, hoping to save one fish, bird, dolphin, or other animal today. So far scientists have estimated 3,000 different SPECIES are now threatened by this oily hazard, and it's not only the wild life, it's the tourists too, thousands of tourists have had to go to the other side of Western View, just to swim without oil, but that may not be true for long, as the oil has been wrapping around the island, getting into rivers and lakes, and threatening the fresh water supply. Luckily the Wessernian government has deployed some of the latest oil removing technology to remove the oil from the water.[/spoiler]
